parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle of the bucket is a curved metal rod attached to the upper rim of the bucket, allowing it to be carried easily.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a grip for lifting and carrying the bucket, transferring the load from the base body to the user's hand.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around its attachment points to the bucket body, allowing it to swing freely for carrying or resting on the sides.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container portion of the bucket, typically made of durable plastic with a tapered cylindrical shape.
parts.Functional_description: It holds liquids or solids, providing the main storage capacity of the bucket.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and rigid, serving as the structural base for the handle and the contents inside.
